notes: VCA305: fix thermal printing wedging until an app restart. report:printReceipt created+destroyed a hidden BrowserWindow per job; across many prints in one session that churn wedged Chromium's print subsystem entirely (dad's KP307 stopped printing; only a restart cleared it). Now ONE hidden print window is reused (never destroyed) and jobs are serialized with a spooler-settle delay, so nothing accumulates. Main-process change → auto-relaunch on update. Needs on-hardware verification (single prints + Print All batch + a full busy session).
